title: Map your evidence to each ladder dimension to find the gap
captions: Start with your company's ladder. Read the next level, not your own. Each dimension says what that level looks like. These five are a simplified example.
Now add your evidence: real work with links. Here the engineer is strong in technical skill and delivery. Those were the skills that got them to mid-level.
Three rows have no evidence. They only took clear tickets, never led work across teams, and never mentored anyone. This is the gap.
Do not try to fix every gap at once. Agree on one or two with your manager, and on the work that will show them.
After a few months, you have evidence in every row. Your manager uses it to write the promotion case. Ladders and processes differ by company.
